summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest, 14/14 passing) + frontend (Playwright) testing of the Crypto Signal Terminal. All 15 requested feature areas verified: JWT auth (login/me/wrong-pwd/401 on protected), strategies list enriched with backtest+paper+gate, create+backfill, backtest metrics + gate update, live toggle gate enforcement (400 when gate_passed=false, 200 when true), scan idempotency, signals feed, paper state, settings GET/PUT, Resend test email (delivered@resend.dev), evolution (generations, regime, OOS fitness, improvement, applied), market/regime, market/candles OHLCV. Frontend: login redirects to dashboard, disclaimer banner, stats bar, candlestick chart (green/red), timeframe selector, signal feed, 3 seeded strategy cards + enabled/live toggles + gate badge, backtest panel with equity curve vs buy-and-hold + verdict, paper panel, Evolution panel with regime badges + verdict + 'Evolve Now', 'Scan All', 'New' strategy dialog (rule editor adds entry/exit rules, saves and card appears), Settings dialog saves + Test email shows 'Test email sent' toast, logout. All critical data-testids present and interactive.

issues: Recharts emits 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on first paint before the container sizes; chart renders fine on next tick. Minor, cosmetic console noise only.
Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description — accessibility warning only.

action_items: (Optional) Pass a Description or aria-describedby prop to Settings/Strategy DialogContent to silence a11y warnings.
(Optional) Give the price chart container a fixed height on first mount to avoid Recharts width(-1) warning.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: solid — bcrypt, JWT 7d expiry, seed_admin re-hashes if admin password changed, protected routes via dependency. OK.
routes.py: live-gate correctly enforced in PUT /strategies/{sid}; backtest endpoint also force-disables live if gate drops. Good.
server.py: unique indexes on signals.sig_key and alerts.idempotency_key provide dedupe at the DB layer in addition to app logic. Nice defense-in-depth.
All MongoDB queries exclude _id — no ObjectId serialization issues observed.

CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is technically contradictory per spec; browsers ignore credentials when origin is '*'. Not a problem for this bearer-token app (no cookies) but worth tightening in production.

Frontend has stable data-testids for every interactive element — reuse them for regression. Backend is on https://signal-engine-158.preview.emergentagent.com, bearer token from POST /api/auth/login.
